- If Value > hiLevel -> hiAlarm=TRUE (trigger)

- Else if hiLevel-hystWindow <= Value <= hiLevel -> retain previous. Note equality at Value = hiLevel? Spec: trigger if > hiLevel, release if < hiLevel-hystWindow, else retain. The LTL P6 says hiLevel-hystWindow<=Value & Value<=hiLevel -> retain, but at Value=hiLevel if hiAlarm false and Value > hiLevel false; no trigger. So yes retain. At Value = hiLevel-hystWindow, release condition is Value < threshold, strict, so equality retains. Good.

- Else if loLevel <= Value <= loLevel+hystWindow -> retain. At Value = loLevel, trigger condition strict <, so equality retains. At Value = loLevel+hystWindow, release strict >, equality retains.

    "states": [
      {"name":"INIT","description":"Fresh instance before first scan; outputs at initial_values."},
      {"name":"VALID","description":"Valid configuration; alarm hysteresis update enabled."},
      {"name":"ERROR_BAD_RANGE","description":"loLevel >= hiLevel; error true, status 16#8001; alarms frozen."},
      {"name":"ERROR_BAD_WINDOW","description":"hystWindow >= hiLevel-loLevel after bad range check; error true, status 16#8002; alarms frozen."}
    ],
    "transitions": [

        {"from":"ANY","to":"SELF","condition":"VALID && loLevel <= Value && Value <= loLevel + hystWindow","action":"retain loAlarm previous value"},
